name: Inktrons #0009
description: Tuned for tight spreads. Inktrons #0009 is a Common Quadwall Alpha, a four-screen monitor wall with a trading console, finished in Midnight. Its screens stream COIN (Coinbase) with mirrored depth bars pulsing on both sides of the book alongside heatmap, candle chart, line + volume, worked by flip toggles and a spinning dial. It comes with an ink drop on top, an ink bottle at its side and a grandfather clock in the corner. Set on a Checker platform against falling hex code. ERC404 on Ink, one of 180.
